fetch_ply_point_cloud: read a PLY file and return a BasicPointCloud with positions, colors, and normals
fetch_ply_with_stride: read a PLY file and subsample the point cloud using a stride value
store_ply_point_cloud: write xyz coordinates, rgb colors, and normals to a PLY file on disk
project_point_3d: project a 3D point into camera image coordinates using extrinsic and intrinsic matrices
project_batch_points: project a batch of 3D points and return valid screen coordinates with a visibility mask
